description: Traceability and analysis content authored outside the platform export to complete the ADS thread (2026-11-13; safety-analysis-to-requirement and Solution-to-design links added 2026-11-14; SysML design attributes and Degree 0 SysML-to-Modelica value bindings added 2026-11-14; FMEDA-row-to-design links and value-binding links added 2026-11-16). Every record is in the export's own record shape and carries origin "completion" and a review status; tools/derive_from_export.py applies this overlay to the export before deriving any view (--no-completion reproduces the export-only views). Mirror each record in the platform at the next re-export (see platformAction).

links.name: FMEA-row17-to-lossOfPowerResponse
links.rationale: Row 17 (UPS battery degraded) states its system and end effect as violation of REQ-ADS-007 (restart within 30 s on loss of off-site power).

cites.element: fault tree (model description; attributed to its top event TE-01)

links.name: BE-12-to-dewpointAccuracy

links.name: BE-17-to-lossOfPowerResponse
links.rationale: BE-17 (UPS battery degraded) is the fault-tree counterpart of FMEDA row 17 and violates REQ-ADS-007.

links.name: IE-07-to-LossOfPowerRequirements

links.name: Sn2-to-changeoverValves

simulation.description: Degree 0 value binding between a SysML attribute and a Modelica parameter: the parameter takes the attribute's value, and the two must be equal. The value is the SysML literal; the parameter's unit is the bracketed unit in its Modelica description. No unit conversion is applied. The modelica runner in tools/reverify.py sets each bound parameter from its attribute before simulating.

linkRelations.scope: Links from a failure-analysis element (FMEDA row, fault-tree event) to a requirement replace a requirement identifier cited in that element's text; `cites` records the text each link replaces, verbatim. The text itself is unchanged. Their kind is the concern pair failure-analysis -> requirements; `relation` says how the source refers to the requirement. Links from a safety-case Solution to a design element make the design itself evidence: their kind is the concern pair safety-case -> design, `relation` architecture, and `cites` records the Solution text (and, where used to disambiguate, its parent Goal's text) that names or denotes the element. Links from an FMEDA row to a design part record the part the row analyses: their kind is the concern pair failure-analysis -> design, `relation` analyses, and `cites` records the row's analysed-item field. Links from a Modelica parameter to a SysML attribute record a value binding: `relation` binds, and `cites` records the binding's label.
linkRelations.challenges: The failure mode, effect or event, if it occurs, violates the target requirement.
linkRelations.realises: The safety mechanism or control the source names implements the target requirement.
linkRelations.architecture: The Solution's argument rests on this design element as built: its redundancy, independence, backup role, containment path or capacity, including the records (proof tests, discharge tests, calibration) that verify it.
linkRelations.analyses: The FMEDA row analyses the target design part: the link records, as a typed link, the design part the row's analysed-item field (itemElement) names.
linkRelations.binds: The Modelica parameter takes its value from the target SysML attribute: the link records, as a typed link, a Degree 0 value binding in simulation.bindings, which carries the value relation.
